name: APOB AI
tagline: Create consistent AI characters, images, videos and talking avatars.
description: APOB AI is a web platform for creating consistent AI characters, images and short videos. Turn text or a reference image into video, create talking avatars, or synchronize lip movements with audio. It is designed for creators producing short visuals and character-led content. An account and generation credits are required. A limited free plan and optional paid plans are available.
